{{Top}}
'''Ixetal cilona''' was the primary constituent of [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]]. It was derived from the [[Balo mushroom/Legends|balo mushroom]] of [[Balosar/Legends|Balosar]].

[[Darth Maladi]] was fond of using Ixetal cilona during her [[Torture/Legends|torture]] sessions. She manufactured the substance and dealt it as well.
